name: classroom-response-system
description: 課堂搶答系統（軟體工程期末專題 SpecKit 組）

scripts.build: npm run build -w @crs/shared && npm run build -w @crs/web && npm run build -w @crs/server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @crs/server" "npm run dev -w @crs/web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p scripts
